steps_unproved: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): Questions a Haiku builder would need. (a) Where does the beat reach the bus? server.py op_flush (line ~326), which returns self.bus.flush(). Add the report there, after the flush. (b) How do I list stuck mail? self.bus.undelivered(limit=1_000_000) returns personal envelopes oldest first, each with id, sender, addressee, why, verb and date (an isoformat string). (c) How do I raise? self.bus.raise_trouble(identity, why=..., detail={...}), the same way server.py _raise_undeliverable_bounce does. (d) How do I avoid re-raising? Keep self._stood_reported = set() in BusProcess.__init__ and skip ids already in it. (e) Is a shim answering? self.roster or the hosted map. Read how no_receiver decides, and carry it as a bool. (f) How does a proof catch the trouble without the live trouble device? Use the scratch-bus rig in proofs/test_mail_without_a_receiver.py, which collects raise_trouble/emission records under a scratch HOME. Copy its trouble-capture approach. (g) How do I age an envelope? Post it, then rewrite its `date` in bus._pending to (now - 700s). (h) What does the reply op return? Keep op_flush's json shape and add a 'stood' count key. All of these ride the ticket's how.

The proof is already written and committed red-first before BUILDME at cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/proofs/test_mail_that_stands_600s_raises.py (4 teeth: mail_that_stands_600s_raises_at_the_flush, it_is_raised_once, younger_mail_is_not_raised, the_flush_still_flushes; PROVES = {'b30069239480': {'all': 'mail_that_stands_600s_raises_at_the_flush', 'exactly one trouble per stuck envelope': 'it_is_raised_once', 'none for an envelope younger than 600s': 'younger_mail_is_not_raised', 'all bus proofs stay green': 'the_flush_still_flushes'}}; its own _Inbox class keeps diagnostic records whose gate == 'raise_trouble'). The builder does NOT write or edit it: run it with bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/proofs/test_mail_that_stands_600s_raises.py' and expect 3 of 4 red before the server.py change and 4 of 4 green after. Exact expressions in BusProcess.report_stood: to = envelope.get('addressee') or ''; sender = envelope.get('sender') or ''; held = to in self.roster.held (roster.held is a list of device ids); identity f'mail-{to}-stood-{STOOD_S}s'; why = f"mail to {to} from {sender} has stood undelivered {'an unknown time' if age is None else f'{int(age)}s'} (over {STOOD_S}s): {envelope.get('why', '')!r}" + ('' if held else f' — no shim for {to} is held'); detail = {'envelope': envelope['id'], 'sender': sender, 'addressee': to, 'why': envelope.get('why', ''), 'verb': envelope.get('verb', ''), 'reply_to': envelope.get('reply_to'), 'date': str(envelope.get('date')), 'age_s': None if age is None else int(age), 'held': held}. The rest of D4's prior text stands: STOOD_S = 600 module constant; self._stood_reported set in __init__; op_flush adds flushed['stood'] = self.report_stood(); _age_s(date, now) helper; skip ids already reported and ages < STOOD_S; add id to the set after raising; return the count.
